_comment: Difficulty levels (SPEC.md §10, M9). Each level is a patch deep-merged over data/rules.json (`rules`) and data/enemies.json (`enemies`) when the mission starts: an object merges key by key, anything else replaces. Every key a patch names must already exist in that file, so a typo fails loudly rather than doing nothing. No code asks which level is on (CLAUDE.md rule 5): a level is only different numbers. Chosen on the orders before the drop, fixed once the stick jumps; `?difficulty=<id>` in the address picks one, as `?seed=` picks a seed. `default` is the level when none is asked for.
_tuning: Balance-bot win % (node tools/balance-bot.mjs 100 naive, DIFFICULTY=<id>), west / north / east run, at M9: see DECISIONS.md for the numbers. The bot never calls the diversion, so the second diversion on Easy helps a person more than the bot shows.

levels.label: Easy
levels.summary: The bridge takes one charge, two men out will do, the RAF can be called twice, orders reach 3 hexes, hiding counts double, enemy shots hit only from 2 hexes off, and undo goes back as far as the start of the turn.

levels.label: Hard
levels.summary: Four men must get out, every sentry and patrol sees a hex further and wider, and blowing a target calls up reinforcements to guard the way out: two squads for the bridge, one for the fuel dump, none once the telephone exchange is down.
